label: Line spacing
intent: The line spacing opens up, driven by the double arrow. Light: the arrow stretches, its heads pushing out 2.2 and stopping dead, and 60 ms later the outer rows are pushed apart from the middle row the same distance; the spread rebounds a touch, then everything closes back quicker with a small settle. Strong: the arrow and rows squeeze in first, then the arrow throws its heads out 3.2 and the rows follow to a hit, rebound twice and close back with a settle. The middle row never moves.

shaft.//: v1's double arrow, split into shaft and heads so it can stretch

shaft.squash.//: shaft half-length 7: squash = 1 - y/7 keeps the shaft meeting the heads
